data.text: CrossbowSaveArrow 0.0.9 is out, with a fix for the hotbar jumping back to a loaded crossbow when scrolling. Installation has changed: put MixinTale-Bootstrap-3.0.0.jar in UserData/EarlyPlugins and CrossbowSaveArrow-0.0.9.jar in UserData/Mods, then enable the mod in the world's Mods tab under Global Mods. Remove the old CrossbowSaveArrow JAR from earlyplugins; Hyxin is no longer needed by this mod, but keep it if another mod requires it. My earlier replies about installing CrossbowSaveArrow in earlyplugins apply to 0.0.8 only. The description now has the full installation and upgrade steps.

Quote from User5:
Having a strange issue where using the scroll wheel to either scroll away from the crossbow, or quickly scroll over the crossbow, causes the selected item to return to the crossbow. I then either wrestle with the scrollwheel to change items, or manually press a number key to select one.

Thanks for the observation! I’m aware of this issue—it stems from the vanilla server-client interaction mechanics. I’m currently working on a fix for it. Appreciate your patience!

replies.text: I was wrong about this being a vanilla bug — the hotbar snap-back and jumping ammo counter were caused by the mod. Fixed in 0.0.9 by changing how the crossbow switches away, without adding a delay. Thanks for reporting it, User5; installation has changed to MixinTale, so please follow the updated description when upgrading.
